feedback: APPROVE. TDD is scope-proportional for a single-file refactor: §3.1/§3.2 specify the exact contract; §4 documents the one-symbol public API; §5/§6/§8 correctly N/A'd (no new data, errors, or untrusted input); 4 ADRs with options+rationale; §13 traceability covers FR-1..FR-10 and NFR-1..NFR-7. Verified against codebase: hello.py and test_hello.py match Appendix A verbatim; PRD reference resolves. No blocking findings.

findings.message: Traceability row for FR-4 lists test_hello_prints_hello_world as exercising the __main__ wiring; this is true only indirectly (the subprocess succeeds iff __main__ calls print(greet())). Acceptable but could be annotated 'indirect'.
Invariant 'module imports nothing' is slightly stronger than what hello.py needs to remain; consider 'no third-party imports' for consistency with §7 / ADR-001 wording.
